_comment: External MCP servers ATOM should mount as additional tool sources. Each server is spawned on demand via stdio. Set 'enabled' to true to activate. Tool names will be prefixed 'mcp_<server>__<tool>' and dispatched through the same SecurityPolicy as built-in actions. Add API keys / secrets to 'env'; they are passed only to the spawned subprocess.

servers.name: filesystem
servers.description: Read/write/list local files under a sandboxed root.

servers.name: git
servers.description: Inspect and operate on a local git repository.

servers.name: fetch
servers.description: Fetch arbitrary HTTP(S) URLs with HTML->markdown conversion.

servers.name: github
servers.description: Read/write GitHub issues, PRs, repos. Requires a PAT in env.
